A '''Sith Scorcher''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage. It was served at the [[Glow Dome]] on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. The drink was set on fire before being served.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
